description: This file defines a test implementation of a stream queue balancer that acquires leases once and doesn't renew them, used for testing queue lease distribution in an Orleans streaming application.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerForTest
classes.description: A dummy implementation of IStreamQueueBalancer for testing purposes, which acquires leases only once without renewal.

methods.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerForTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the balancer with a name and grain factory.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lease manager with all queues and gets the initial lease responsibility.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs a shutdown operation (no specific cleanup in this implementation).

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues owned by this balancer.

methods.name: GetInitialLease
methods.description: Acquires initial lease responsibilities from the lease manager.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to queue distribution change events (no-op).

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes from queue distribution change events (no-op).
